{{Top|leg}}
The '''glowfly''' or '''glow-fly''' was a type of bioluminescent [[Insect/Legends|insect]] native to [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. They were known for their fast, darting movements, which created beautiful patterns in the evening.
